title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and introduce reusable CI templates
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: our GitHub Actions workflows had substantial duplication across lint, test, and release flows which makes maintenance slow and increases the chance of drift between repos. This PR consolidates common steps into reusable workflows, upgrades action versions and Node runtime references to Node 20, standardizes caching and matrix parallelism, and tunes job timeouts to reduce flakiness.

What this changes: - Add .github/workflows/reusable-ci.yml with reusable jobs for checkout, setup-node, cache-restore/save, install, lint, test, and publish hooks. - Replace duplicated workflows (lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml) with thin callers that use the reusable workflow. - Upgrade actions/checkout, actions/setup-node, and cache actions to latest pinned versions and use node: 20.x in CI matrices. - Introduce a small shared scripts/ci/cache-helpers.sh for consistent cache keys across repos. - Reduce test job matrix to only necessary combinations and enable parallelism on slow suites; optimize caching to reduce cold runs. - Add additional retry logic for known flaky integration tests and a short delay before e2e cluster teardown. - Update CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/ci.md with the new workflow conventions and examples.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidate and add reusable workflow - [x] Upgrade Node to 20.x across workflows - [x] Pin GH Actions versions and add minimal breaking-change notes - [x] Run full CI across redwood monorepo and redwood-sdk-python example - [x] Update docs and templates for repo hygiene

Notes: This is primarily a repo-hygiene and devtools change; no runtime production code changes were included. The release workflow now triggers via the reusable workflow and retains the same gating (release-tag, manual dispatch for canaries). See linked Linear items for rollout plan and follow-ups.

review_comments: Evan Zhao: Nice consolidation. A few requests: (1) please add a short section in docs/ci.md explaining how to call the reusable workflow with secrets, (2) ensure the matrix still runs node 18 for one job for backwards compatibility for a while, and (3) can we pin action SHAs for critical steps?

Asha Patel: Responding — added docs section and example callers; left a single node 18 job in the matrix for a 3-month deprecation window; pinned critical action SHAs where the maintainers recommended pinning. See commit 'chore: pin critical actions'.
Sofia Martinez: CI runtimes look good. One minor nit: cache key entropy should include package-lock hash for monorepo installs. I left an inline suggestion in scripts/ci/cache-helpers.sh.
Asha Patel: Incorporated the package-lock hash into the cache key, and added comments explaining the key format. Ran full monorepo CI after change and benchmarked cache hit rate improvements.
Liam O'Connor: Approving pending green CI and a follow-up ticket to migrate other repos to the template. Please add release notes summarizing runtime impacts.
Asha Patel: Added release notes and linked ENG follow-ups. CI is green and this is ready to merge.
